extends.compatibility: Absent requested.promptEnhancement preserves legacy direct generation. Never infer the flag from prompt content.

request.instruction: Nonblank well-formed UTF-16, maximum 8000 code units; no controls except CR, LF and TAB. Immutable resolved user selections, AI alternatives and planning settings captured on explicit enqueue.
request.unknownOrFuture: Reject without mutation; never silently downgrade to direct generation.

execution.timing: After durable FIFO claim under the existing single GPU queue lease, using the pinned source, before starting H3 inference. Enqueue, passive reads, and paused queues never run prompt inference.
execution.runtime: Use the existing sealed local rewrite runtime and compiler. Stop the owned rewrite runtime before loading H3; bounded 360-second operation with Jobs cancellation.
execution.content: Preserve the original requested.prompt, saved styles and Japanese notes. Apply the validated candidate to an execution-only copy. Preserve protected dialogue through the existing H3 compiler.
execution.receipt: diagnostics.promptEnhancement records schemaVersion=1, current runId, state running/succeeded/failed/canceled; succeeded also stores candidatePrompt, sourceSha256 and rewriteRevision. Failed optional enrichment may set fallbackUsed=true and a warning while the video Job continues. Never treat a previous run receipt as current execution authority.
execution.failure: For invalid generated output only, allow one correction attempt, then continue with the exact frozen effective.positivePrompt and record fallbackUsed=true with the controlled cause and warning. Cancellation, unknown cancellation state, source identity, runtime ownership, sealing, timeout and cleanup failures remain terminal. Retry preserves the immutable request and performs a fresh attempt.
execution.identity: The original video snapshot and presetHash remain immutable. Execution prompt is an attempt result, not a new user request.

ui.off: Resolve manual/default options locally. H3 conformance diagnostics do not block enqueue or require AI. Syntax/resource errors still report accurately.
ui.on: Enqueue first; show that AI enhancement runs when the Job reaches execution. Closing the editor after publication does not cancel the durable Job.
